title: 2026 UK CBAM Carbon Price Relief calculation QA controls

sources.title: Work out your Carbon Price Relief
Claiming Carbon Price Relief for Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)

facts.source_fact: Carbon Price Relief requires working out an effective carbon price, calculating relief, and converting the relief figure where needed.
Before calculation, the importer needs a completed independently verified carbon-pricing verification form for one of the two calendar years before the import year.
Publicly available carbon-pricing information is required for the calculation.
Free allowances or thresholds with no price are not included in the effective carbon-price numerator.
facts.expected_handling: Do not assign an artificial positive price.

facts.source_fact: The calculation multiplies emissions subject to each priced scheme element by its price, totals those amounts, then divides by total installation emissions.
Relevant public prices for headline carbon price, GGR or graduated pricing use the previous calendar quarter and a mean average where the price is not fixed.
facts.expected_handling: Version price by the prior quarter.

facts.source_fact: Compensation listed for the same emissions year is divided by total installation emissions and subtracted from the effective carbon price.
facts.expected_handling: Apply compensation after base effective-price calculation.

facts.source_fact: Carbon Price Relief is calculated by multiplying the effective carbon price by embodied emissions subject to the qualifying carbon-pricing scheme for each CBAM good.
Foreign-currency relief must be converted to GBP using HMRC exchange rates for the calendar quarter before the point of import.
facts.expected_handling: Use the correct currency and quarter.

facts.source_fact: After conversion, relief is rounded down to two decimal places and cannot exceed the CBAM liability due.
facts.expected_handling: Apply rounding and liability cap last.

guard_patterns.handling: Exclude free allowances and zero-price thresholds from priced numerator.
Keep tCO2e and price-per-tCO2e dimensions consistent.
Apply compensation adjustment in the specified sequence.
Cap relief at liability due and round down at the end.
Do not infer parcel emissions from CBAM relief data.
Flag conflicting price, currency, emissions or form data.
